title: Infill Case \| iphone 17 - 14
author: Mesmar
description:
Slim and elegant phone case with camera protection designed for iPhone.

The back can be customized with various infill patterns by editing the modifier settings.

The available models:

- 17 standard
- 16 standard/Pro/Pro Max
- 15 standard/Pro/Pro Max
- 14 standard/Pro/Pro Max
- 13 standard

### Important notes:

- #### TPU is highly recommended as it will provide better protection and reliability. PLA/PETG is stiff and can easily crack or scratch the phone frame.

- #### PLA/PETG profiles should only be printed with Cubic or honeycomb infills to avoid the infill from splitting from the frame.
